lines: This season, when spring approached little by little.
To assess the results of all our training so far, a number of tests were held at Gosha Academy.
One of those was this “exam mission”.
The gist was to make the students carry out the mission with an “improvised team” that was different from usual, and gauge their overall development.
That was why, this time, I was teamed up not with my usual Commando Unit, but with people like Mari and Mai.
Me
「Well, that wraps things up for now. Good job, everyone!」
I called out to Mari and Mai, my “improvised team” members.
This was a zone on the outskirts of the downtown area, where there was little foot traffic.
We were hiding ourselves here, waiting for one more member to return.
Mari
「Yes! Thank you for the hard work, Fuuma-san♪」
Mai
「Surprisingly, those people were all show, no substance.」
Me
「No, I have a feeling it's just that you guys are overwhelmingly strong......」
We were talking about the prior battle with the hoodlum orcs.
Even if they were guys from a fledgling organization, there was no doubt that they were also a bunch of powerful dwellers of the underworld.
In spite of that, Mari and Mai had used seamless coordination to beat up the orcs in no time.
Those guys had now been tied up tight, and tossed into a nearby abandoned building.
They would probably remain safe and unconscious until we left this underworld town.
Mai
「Strong? Really?」
Mari
「You are! Mai-chan's Paper Spirit powers are incredibly strong and useful. I was thinking, “That's amazing” too!」
Mai
「No, no. I still have a long way to go, compared to Mari-chan-senpai.」
Mari
「Not at all♪ Mai-chan is amazing!!」
Mari
「Right?! You think so too, right, Fuuma-san?♪」
Mai
「Fuuma-san, you please tell Mari-chan-senpai that her amazingness is on a whole other level.」
Me
「You're both amazing!!!」
What was with these two......?
They both had a sort of natural airheadedness to them, albeit of different types, so I did sometimes get confused when talking with them.
“Well, that's fun in its own way, though――”
“Improvised team” members Shinohara Mari and Nanase Mai.
Mari was an outstanding Earth Escape-using Taimanin, who also served as the neighbouring class's president.
She seemed to be on close terms with Hebiko, her fellow class rep, and I had also become friends with her through that connection.
And Paper Spirit user Nanase Mai was Mari's classmate.
A short while ago, we had worked together on a request from Chevalier.
She was taciturn, and it was hard to tell at a glance what she was thinking, but she seemed to like books and reading, so she was undoubtedly a good person.
And then, the other one――
Mari
「All that's left is to wait for Una-chan to get back, right?」
Me
「Yeah. Going by her transmission earlier, she was seriously freaked by the bomb that she planted herself, though......」
The final member of the “improvised team” was Mochizuki Una.
She was a Beast Escape Art-using Taimanin who harboured the powers of a rabbit within her.
Where fighting was concerned, she specialized in close-quarters combat, pairing tough leg strength with Anti-Demon killing moves――
And also, because she had outstanding hearing and explosive energy, she was expected to excel as a scout and spy.
For this mission, I had entrusted that Una with the infiltration of the BS Gang hideout.
While we were distracting those guys, her role was to steal their account book, which was proof of their illegal transactions.
Mai
「I take it that Una-chan isn't good with loud noises, or being alone.」
Mai
「When that becomes really bad, she gets overactive bladder, so she's got it tough.」
Me
「Seriously? I mean, how does that work as a scout, if she doesn't like being on her own?」
Mari
「It's all right! When Una-chan is lonely, we all talk to her through texts and our communicators!」
Me
「Come to think of it, I got an awful lot of texts earlier......」
Were those less mission reports, and more her distracting from her loneliness?
“No wonder she was only talking about completely unrelated stuff, like sports,” I thought.
Then, at that time.
Me
「Oh? Speak of the devil――」
A transmission came in from Una on my communicator.
Me
「Good work, Una! How's it going? You getting here soon?」
Una
『I-I'll be there, I'll be there!! I'm almost there——Hieeeeeeeeeeh?!!』
Me
I cocked my head.
Then, extremely surprised-sounding voices from Mari and Mai.
Mari
「Ah?! Una-chan's arrived――But, what's that?」
Mai
「Something's strange, isn't it?」
Una
「Pyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah?!!!」
Una
「Gonna die gonna die gonna diiieee!! Fuuma-kun, help meeeeeeeeeeeeeee!!!」
Trolls
「GOAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!!」
Me
「Huuuuuuuhhh?!!!!」
Rabbit Taimanin Mochizuki Una came running, half-crying, with a smallish briefcase in her arms――
And closing in from behind her, with earth-shaking steps, were humungous trolls.
